FLAME.name: Flame Armour
FLAME.canon: Spirit Dive with the fire spirit Salamander: Fuegoleon's arms cloaked in fire mana with draconic scales, claws and fiery wings (Fana hosts it too); Fuegoleon's Flame Armour is the everyday armour. FORM: Spirit Dive (mana upkeep, ambient intake); explicit page: Flame Armour.

WATER.name: Valkyrie Armour
WATER.canon: Noelle Silva's Valkyrie Armor / Valkyrie Dress (water armour of the Sea Dragon) and, with the water spirit Undine, the Saint Valkyrie Dress (feathered wing-like parts and a halo). Spirit Dive is the form; Valkyrie Dress and Sea Dragon's Scale Mail are the explicit armour pages.

ICE.canon: Ice spells are shots, walls and constructs (repo wiki: Heavenly Ice Fang, Cage of Infinite Hail ...); nothing is worn.

MERCURY.name: Silver Guardian
MERCURY.canon: Mercury Magic: Silver Guardian (repo wiki spell page): the mercury becomes a defensive coating over the whole body, solid enough to block repeated strikes, flexible enough not to hinder movement, and poisonous to the user (hence the health upkeep). Nozel Silva's magic.

WIND.name: Spirit of Zephyr
WIND.canon: Yuno's Spirit Dive with the wind spirit Sylph (Spirit of Zephyr): the first dive transforms only the left half (one wing, half a crown, a ring round the wrist), the full dive has two wings and a full crown. Spirit Dive is the form; the Zephyr page is the older overlay (blackclover.ModeArmor).

EARTH.name: Gnome Plate
EARTH.canon: The earth spirit exists in the lore but its name, look and host were never shown, so the dive is a generic earth spirit dive (the mod calls the spirit Gnome). Spirit Dive is the form; Gnome Plate is the explicit armour page.

LIGHT.canon: Light Magic is rays, swords and healing (repo wiki: Healing Ray of Light, Light Sword of Judgment). The Light spirit form exists only as a spirit lord summon in this mod; a future Light Spirit Dive would be a FORM (follow-up), there is no worn armour to put on today.

LIGHTNING.name: Lightning Armour
LIGHTNING.canon: Luck Voltia's lightning armour (Thunder Fiend, Black Lightning Battle Fiend, Raging Lightning: the white-and-gold armour with bolts of docs/mode_armor_spec.md). The three Fiend pages are the explicit armour pages.

DARK.name: Dark Cloaked
DARK.canon: Yami Sukehiro's Dark Cloaked: his body and blades coated in dark mana (obsidian plate, horned hood, tattered cape in the mod). Dark Cloaked Guard is the explicit armour page; the Dark Cloaked slashes are spells, not armour.

SHADOW.name: Devil Unite (Nacht)
SHADOW.canon: Nacht Faust's Devil Unite modes with his devils (Slotos, Gimodelo, Plumede, Walgner): a body-wide transformation with its own armour overlay. The Unite pages (shadow.UniteState, blackclover.ModeArmor) are the explicit form pages and are left as they are.

ANTI_MAGIC.name: Devil Union (Black Asta)
ANTI_MAGIC.canon: Asta and the devil Liebe: Devil Union. No mana; Anti-Magic coats the body and erases, cuts or repels any magic it touches; horns, tail, slit pupils and pitch-black jagged armour. It needs a Devil-Binding Ritual contract (Asta's is an Equal Contract: the pair must synchronise thoughts, pain and motivation); a strict time limit of five minutes, then the form shatters and the user is incapacitated by muscle pain for about thirty minutes. The mod's Black Form toggle (antimagic.AntiMagicLordSkill, Demon Mode overlay, Aura gauge) is the form and is left as it is.
